生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven, Riven's Broken Sword,
and Burning Settlement references for visual continuity.

Riven is in her Two Years Later appearance.

She carries only the HANDLE-SIDE REMAINING HALF
of her broken sword.

The missing upper half is completely gone.

The remaining sword is still large and broad,
ending in a rough fractured break with no pointed tip.

The Broken Sword remains completely dormant.

No rune glow.
No magical energy.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Dark mountain forest at dusk.

Natural human movement.

Realistic fast running with proper body weight and momentum.

Natural hair and cloth movement.

Dynamic but controlled cinematic camera movement.

Natural footsteps, breathing, wind, distant fire,
voices, and environmental sound.

English dialogue.

Natural lip sync.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No combat.

Keep the geography simple and easy to understand.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven is already sprinting at full speed along a mountain trail,
heading toward the distant fire.

Begin immediately with a close low-angle view of her running feet.

Do not begin with a wide establishing shot.

Show only a short section of her fast journey through the mountain forest.

Use a foreground object passing across the lens
to create a natural travel transition.

After this transition,
Riven is much closer to the burning settlement.

People suddenly begin running past her
in the opposite direction.

Civilians and soldiers are fleeing from the settlement.

Riven slows down and asks a retreating soldier what happened.

He only tells her to run.

Everyone continues escaping.

Riven looks toward the burning settlement.

Instead of following them,
she walks alone toward the fire.


=== SHOT 1 — THE RUN ===

OPEN IMMEDIATELY on a low close-up tracking shot
of Riven's boots already running at full speed.

She is already sprinting.

Do not show her standing still.

Do not begin with a wide view.

Do not show the cabin.

The camera stays very low beside the mountain trail,
tracking rapidly with her movement.

Her boots strike the dirt hard and naturally.

Loose dirt and small stones move beneath her steps.

Gradually raise the camera into a closer tracking view of Riven.

She is running at full speed through the dark mountain forest.

Her breathing is strong.

Her expression is focused.

Her pale-blonde hair and clothing move naturally
with the speed of her run.

The Broken Sword remains secured on her body.

She does not hold it in her hands while running.

Continue following Riven as she runs along
the rugged mountain trail.

Keep the camera relatively close to her.

Trees, rocks, and mountain terrain move quickly past her,
creating a strong sense of speed.

Do not spend a long time showing the journey.

After a short sequence of continuous running,
Riven passes very close to a large foreground tree trunk
or dark rock.

The foreground object moves completely across the lens
until the entire frame is naturally obscured.

Use this moment as a TRAVEL TRANSITION.

During the hidden cut,
time and distance have passed.


=== SHOT 2 — EVERYONE IS RUNNING AWAY ===

Continue immediately from the foreground transition.

Riven is still running with the same forward momentum,
but she is now much closer to the source of the fire.

This is clearly a later point in her journey.

The forest is thinner.

Smoke is much heavier.

Ash drifts through the air.

Orange firelight is stronger.

The sound of burning wood is now clearly audible.

Riven continues running toward the source.

Suddenly—

a civilian runs past her in the opposite direction.

Riven briefly reacts but keeps moving.

Then another civilian passes her.

Then several more people emerge through the smoke,
all running in the opposite direction.

They are fleeing from somewhere ahead.

Several soldiers are also retreating with them.

Riven begins to slow down.

As she slows,
reveal the burning settlement ahead through the smoke.

Buildings are burning.

Firelight flickers through the road.

Smoke rises above the settlement.

Everyone is moving AWAY from it.

One retreating soldier passes close to Riven.

Riven turns toward him and asks:

"What happened?"

The soldier barely slows down.

He looks frightened and urgently answers:

"Just run!"

He immediately continues running away with the others.

Do not explain what they are escaping from.

Do not reveal the mysterious figure.

Riven watches the soldier disappear into the fleeing crowd.


=== SHOT 3 — AGAINST THE FLOW ===

Riven stops.

For a brief moment,
she stands while civilians and soldiers continue rushing past her.

The movement around her has one clear direction:

everyone is leaving the burning settlement.

Riven looks at the fleeing people.

Then she slowly turns her attention back toward the fire.

Ahead of her is the smoke-filled road leading into the settlement.

Hold briefly on Riven's restrained reaction.

She does not know what is inside.

She does not draw her Broken Sword.

She does not prepare for combat.

Then Riven begins walking forward.

Move the camera backward in front of her.

Riven walks toward the burning settlement
while civilians and soldiers continue passing around her
in the opposite direction.

Keep the visual contrast extremely clear:

EVERYONE ELSE IS MOVING OUT.

RIVEN IS MOVING IN.

As Riven advances,
the crowd gradually becomes thinner.

Fewer people pass her.

The orange firelight grows stronger across her face and clothing.

Smoke becomes thicker around the road.

Eventually the last few fleeing people pass Riven.

She is now almost alone.

Riven continues walking deeper toward the burning settlement.

The road ahead disappears gradually into smoke and firelight.

Do not reveal the mysterious figure.

Do not show strange black markings.

Do not begin combat.

Riven continues forward into the smoke.

CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven has reached the burning settlement.

Civilians and soldiers are fleeing from it.

Riven has chosen to go inside while everyone else escapes.

She still carries only the remaining handle-side half
of her Broken Sword.

The Broken Sword remains dormant.

She has not yet seen what caused the destruction.

CUT.、16:9
